from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from rest_framework.response import Response
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import GeneralLedgerEntry
from .serializers import LedgerEntrySerializer

class VoidedLedgerEntryUndeleteView(generics.GenericAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = LedgerEntrySerializer

    def post(self, request, entry_uuid):
        # Enforce that the voided entry belongs to the caller's organization
        entry = get_object_or_404(
            GeneralLedgerEntry.deleted_objects,
            uuid=entry_uuid,
            organization=request.user.organization
        )
        entry.undelete()

        return Response({
            "entry_uuid": str(entry.uuid),
            "amount": str(entry.amount),
            "account_code": entry.account_code,
            "status": "active"
        })
